plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to eliminate that risk.
Reduce semiconductor exposure by selling SMH.
Trim the income ETF (QQQI) to reduce concentration.
Increase broad index exposure by adding to SPY.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation with reduced leverage and concentration.
Expect lower volatility and a more stable portfolio.
conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for capital preservation with reduced volatility. Target monthly returns will be lower due to de-risking and holding more cash. Significant drawdowns are unlikely but possible in severe market downturns.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to reduce overall risk.
Reduce concentration in income (QQQI) and semiconductors (SMH).
Add exposure to a defensive sector by buying XLV.
This plan balances growth with risk reduction.
It aims for steady growth while managing leverage and concentration.
Expect moderate volatility and potential for steady gains.
balanced.read: This balanced plan seeks risk-first growth by trimming leverage and concentration. It aims for moderate returns with controlled drawdowns. Expect a steadier path compared to aggressive strategies, with less sensitivity to sharp market moves.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) for amplified gains.
Trim income ETF (QQQI) to free up capital for higher-growth areas.
Increase concentration in semiconductors (SMH) and add XLV.
This plan aggressively pursues growth through leverage and concentration.
It accepts higher potential drawdowns for amplified upside.
Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage risk.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for maximum growth by increasing leverage and concentration in high-conviction areas. Expect higher potential returns but also significantly larger drawdowns and increased volatility. Leveraged ETF decay is a factor to monitor closely.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs and high-beta tech/semiconductor holdings.
Increase allocation to income-focused ETF QQQI.
Maintain broad market exposure with SPY.
This plan prioritizes generating steady income over growth.
It aims for low drawdowns and reliable monthly distributions.
Expect modest returns primarily from income, with limited capital appreciation.
income.read: This income-focused plan prioritizes capital preservation and steady distributions. Returns will be modest and primarily from income generation, with limited capital appreciation potential. Drawdowns are expected to be minimal, but NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
